title: build_credential_store_inner two-function split is necessary but worth a comment
description: build_credential_store wraps build_credential_store_inner solely to convert BuildStoreError→String at the outer boundary. The split is correct (avoids stringly-typing the inner error path) but the outer function's doc comment doesn't explain why two functions exist. A reader will wonder if it's dead code or a pattern. Suggested: add a one-line comment on build_credential_store: '// Thin wrapper; converts BuildStoreError to String at the startup boundary.'
